question: Will Thomas Chalifoux be the Republican nominee for FL-09?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins the nomination for the Republican Party to contest the FL-09 congressional district seat in the U.S. House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm elections. The Republican primary will take place on August 18, 2026.

If no nominee is announced by November 3, 2026, 11:59PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of official Republican sources, including https://www.rnc.org/.

Any replacement of the nominee before election day will not change the resolution of the market.

evidence.publisher: Dan Green for Congress, reproducing reporting by Peter Schorsch of Florida Politics
evidence.excerpt: U.S. Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio, who chairs the House Judiciary Committee, and U.S. Rep. Mike Haridopolos, the Space Coast Republican and former Florida Senate President, are endorsing Green, a Donald Trump Pentagon appointee, in the Republican Primary for the redrawn Florida’s 9th Congressional District. Green shares the ballot with Ben Butler, Marcus Carter, Thomas Chalifoux, Jorge Martinez, Steve Rance and Justin Story. The Primary is Aug. 18.

Thomas Chalifoux is launching a $1 million ad buy as he competes in the crowded Republican Primary in Florida’s 9th Congressional District. The Chalifoux campaign said the districtwide effort represents its largest communications investment to date. It includes broadcast and cable TV advertising as well as digital running through the election on Aug. 18. The campaign’s first spot, titled “Not a Suckup,” began airing Tuesday.

evidence.publisher: Dan Green for Congress, reproducing reporting by Peter Schorsch of Florida Politics
evidence.excerpt: Dan Green, the war veteran and former Donald Trump appointee running in Florida’s 9th Congressional District, is putting his military biography front and center in his first television ad. The spot, titled “Conservative Warrior,” is now airing across the district. Green’s campaign launched the ad after announcing a $1.14 million fundraising haul over two weeks, driven by Green’s strong self-funding push.

evidence.publisher: WKMG News 6 / ClickOrlando — Christie Zizo and Christopher Heath
evidence.excerpt: At noon on Friday, Florida’s candidate qualifying came to an end with hundreds of candidates qualified for congressional races across Florida’s 28 Congressional districts. Seven Republicans have qualified for the Aug. 18 primary to decide who will be the one to face Soto in November.

Republican congressional candidate Ben Butler announced Thursday that he has secured endorsements from a broad slate of elected officials in Okeechobee County, adding to the growing list of local and federal support behind his campaign in Florida’s 9th Congressional District. The endorsements include Okeechobee County Sheriff Noel Stephen, Okeechobee Mayor Dowling Watford Jr., the entire Okeechobee County Board of County Commissioners and all five members of the Okeechobee County School Board. The candidate has also received endorsements from U.S. Reps. Kat Cammack and Greg Steube.
